purpose: Documentary identity record for the names La Capitana, Hualaca and Higuerón (Tumbes). Every statement rests on a verbatim quote from an official source archived in this PR with its real SHA-256. It does not create channels, catchments, outlets, receivers, events in any ledger, thresholds or map layers.

provenance.text_reading_method: pypdf text layer (PDF) or tag-stripped HTML, extracted from the archived bytes on the capture runner and stored in text/*.pages.json. No OCR, no LLM summarisation.
provenance.quote_rule: Each quote is a verbatim (whitespace-normalised) substring of the archived text page it cites; tests re-check this against files whose SHA-256 matches the manifest.
provenance.map_label_caveat: Map PDFs (ANA 2016) are read through their text layer. The order of labels in the extraction is not a spatial order: two labels printed next to each other in a quote need not be neighbours on the map.

duplicate_check.main: On main 879f925, 'La Capitana' appears only as a settlement name in tumbes_rio_tumbes_official_evidence_v0_1.json and phase2_discovery_packages/tumbes_rio_tumbes.json (INDECI 2024-02-20). No quebrada La Capitana, no Tumbes Higuerón, no Hualaca and no Hualtacal anywhere on main. The national audit has one homonym outside Tumbes: piura_lalaquiz_el_higueron.
duplicate_check.open_pull_requests: All 30 open PRs (#309–#364) diffed against main on 2026-10-08: no hunk names Hualaca, Higuerón, Capitana or Hualtacal except this PR.

provenance.storage: Original bytes, text extractions and the manifest live in data/phase2/source_archive/tumbes_capitana_hualaca_higueron/, outside site/ (the only directory GitHub Pages publishes). They were moved there with git mv on 2026-10-09; bytes and SHA-256 are unchanged.

requested: Incorporate Hualaca from ANA Anexo II DU 015-2023, row 17, archived with its real SHA-256, without presupposing same or different channel as Higuerón.
Keep undemonstrated relations UNRESOLVED: two names in official sources do not prove two hydraulically independent channels.
Move the original PDFs out of site/ while keeping traceability, hashes and automated checks.

provenance.relation_rule: Two different names in official sources show that the sources use two labels. They do not show two hydraulically independent channels: one channel can carry different names by reach or by sector, and two names can belong to connected channels. Without reproducible geometry no relation is asserted.

identity_decisions.question: ¿Hualaca e Higuerón son el mismo cauce, cauces distintos, o no se puede resolver?
identity_decisions.basis: ANA (Anexo II del DU 015-2023, fila 17) lists 'Qda. Hualaca' in distrito San Jacinto, sector 'Higueron'. Other sources name a 'quebrada Higuerón' (INGEMMET A6764 C-28; Ley 32573 §1.2; ANA 2016 maps). The row gives Higuerón as the sector of the Hualaca critical point; it does not say whether Hualaca is the quebrada Higuerón, a reach or tributary of it, or a separate channel. Two different names in official sources show that the sources use two labels. They do not show two hydraulically independent channels: one channel can carry different names by reach or by sector, and two names can belong to connected channels. Without reproducible geometry no relation is asserted.

identity_decisions.question: ¿Hualaca y Hualtacal son el mismo cauce?
identity_decisions.basis: Anexo II gives them separate rows (17 'Qda. Hualaca', sector Higueron; 18 'Qda. Hualtacal', sector Rica Playa), both in San Jacinto. Separate rows in a list of critical points are separate intervention points, not proof of separate channels. The earlier hypothesis that 'Hualaca' might be a spelling of 'Hualtacal' is withdrawn: both labels appear in the same table. Two different names in official sources show that the sources use two labels. They do not show two hydraulically independent channels: one channel can carry different names by reach or by sector, and two names can belong to connected channels. Without reproducible geometry no relation is asserted.

identity_decisions.question: ¿Higuerón y Hualtacal son el mismo cauce?
identity_decisions.basis: Ley 32573 §1.2 enumerates 'quebrada Higuerón y quebrada Hualtacal' on one side of a divide; ANA 2016 map 3743 prints both labels. The enumeration shows two labels, not two independent channels. Two different names in official sources show that the sources use two labels. They do not show two hydraulically independent channels: one channel can carry different names by reach or by sector, and two names can belong to connected channels. Without reproducible geometry no relation is asserted.

identity_decisions.question: ¿La Capitana e Higuerón son el mismo cauce?
identity_decisions.basis: INGEMMET A6764 Cuadro 3.2 gives separate road-damage rows (C-27 quebrada La Capitana, C-28 quebrada Higuerón); ANA 2016 maps print separate labels. Separate rows are separate damaged road sections, not proof of independent channels. Two different names in official sources show that the sources use two labels. They do not show two hydraulically independent channels: one channel can carry different names by reach or by sector, and two names can belong to connected channels. Without reproducible geometry no relation is asserted.

identity_decisions.question: ¿La Capitana y Hualaca son el mismo cauce?
identity_decisions.basis: No source names both. Anexo II does not list La Capitana; INGEMMET and ANA 2016 do not name Hualaca. Two different names in official sources show that the sources use two labels. They do not show two hydraulically independent channels: one channel can carry different names by reach or by sector, and two names can belong to connected channels. Without reproducible geometry no relation is asserted.

identity_decisions.question: ¿Las menciones de 'quebrada Higuerón' en Tumbes se refieren a un solo cauce?
identity_decisions.basis: Contexts: (A) road crossing INGEMMET C-28 on the San Jacinto road; (B) Contralmirante Villar–Tumbes interprovincial divide (Ley 32573 §1.2); (C) ANA 2016 sheets that print both 'Q. Higuerón' and 'Quebrada Higueron'. In addition, Anexo II uses 'Higueron' as the sector of Qda. Hualaca. Text alone cannot tell how many channels these refer to.

identity_decisions.question: ¿Las menciones de 'Hualtacal' se refieren a un solo cauce?
identity_decisions.basis: Hualtacal appears on the Contralmirante Villar–Tumbes divide (Ley 32573 §1.2), as the upstream name of a quebrada Seca on the Canoas de Punta Sal / Casitas / Zorritos boundary (Ley 32573), on ANA 2016 sheets for Cancas and Canoas de Punta Sal, and as a critical point in San Jacinto, sector Rica Playa (Anexo II, fila 18). How many channels these are is not stated.

identity_decisions.question: ¿'La Capitana' es una quebrada o un centro poblado?
identity_decisions.basis: INGEMMET A6764 names the 'quebrada La Capitana'; ANA 2016 prints 'Q Capitana' and the centro poblado label 'LA CAPITANA'; INDECI 2024 and COEN 2025 name La Capitana / Capitana as a centro poblado / caserío. No source states how the settlement relates to the quebrada.

identity_decisions.question: ¿'Higuerón' es una quebrada o un caserío/sector?
identity_decisions.basis: Quebrada Higuerón: INGEMMET C-28, Ley 32573, ANA 2016 maps. Sector/caserío Higuerón: road name 'Casa Blanqueada - Higuerón - Rica Playa', INGEMMET zones 2 and 8, ANA 3743 labels 'HIGUERON' and 'HIGUERON SECO', COEN 2025 'caseríos de Capitana e Higuerón', and the SECTOR column of Anexo II row 17. No source states how the sector relates to the quebrada.

identity_decisions.question: ¿El 'sector Capitán Hoyle' del Reporte Complementario 13112 (San Jacinto, 27/9/2026) es La Capitana?
identity_decisions.basis: Different label in the source and no source relating them; not equated. RC 13112 and RC 13111 do not name La Capitana, Higuerón, Hualaca or Hualtacal (absence of a name is not evidence of inactivity).

identity_decisions.question: ¿Las quebradas El Higuerón de Piura, Cajamarca o La Libertad tienen relación con Tumbes?
identity_decisions.basis: The sources place them in other departments (ANA 2016 Piura map: Lalaquiz, San Miguel de El Faique; SIGRID documents for Paimas, San Ignacio and Mocan/Casa Grande). The capture logged the latter as CAPTURED_NOT_RETAINED_OUTSIDE_TUMBES_CONTEXT; none is attached to a Tumbes record.

sector_level_context.statement: Zona crítica 'Capitana-Rica Playa (San Jacinto)', several short quebradas, listed among zones that activated with El Niño Costero 2017. Sector-level; not attributed to quebrada La Capitana alone.

units.province_note: Not assigned. Attestation A is on a road in San Jacinto (provincia Tumbes); attestation B lies on the Contralmirante Villar–Tumbes interprovincial divide and the law does not say on which side the quebrada drains.

attestations.context: Road crossing, Cuadro 3.2 C-28, PE-1N (Pte. Mayor Novoa)–San Pedro de los Incas–San Jacinto–Puente Francos.
Legal boundary description, Tramo interprovincial Contralmirante Villar – Tumbes: divide between the quebrada Tumbes and the quebradas Chaparias, Piedra Candela, Maderales, Higuerón and Hualtacal.
ANA 2016 map labels. Sheets 3743 and 3755 each print two spellings ('Q. Higuerón' and 'Quebrada Higueron'); sheets 3751, 3747 and 3753 print one of them.

sector_level_context.statement: Zona crítica 'Higuerón (San Jacinto)': derrumbes; 'En 1998, se produjeron derrumbes que afectaron viviendas'. A sector (settlement) and a slope process, not a flow of the quebrada Higuerón.
Zona crítica 'Higuerón–Casa Blanqueada Oidor (San Jacinto)': flujos de lodo in several short quebradas along this stretch, activated with El Niño Costero 2017. Sector-level.

units.location_basis: Anexo II of DU 015-2023, section I - TUMBES, row 17: DEPARTAMENTO Tumbes, PROVINCIA Tumbes, DISTRITO San Jacinto, SECTOR Higueron. Column order from the table header; checked visually on the rendered page.

source_stated_hydrographic_fields_not_ad.note: Printed administrative/hydrographic columns are recorded as text. 'Tumbes' in the CUENCA column is not adopted as a parent basin, receiver or outlet: the table gives no channel line, confluence or coordinates.

homonyms_kept_apart: Qda. Hualtacal (Anexo II row 18, sector Rica Playa)

critical_point_listings.statement: Listed by ANA as a critical point for cleaning and desilting (limpieza y descolmatación) under DU 015-2023 (June 2023). A planned intervention list, not an event, a footprint or a capacity statement.

statements.statement: INDECI (2024-02-20) lists La Capitana among six centros poblados that a Río Tumbes high flow measured at Cabo Inga 'podría afectar'. An exposure warning for the Río Tumbes, not an event of any quebrada.

COEN RC 3755 (2025-03-18) reports that on 17/3/2025 the Municipalidad Distrital de San Jacinto cleaned and rehabilitated roads in the caseríos Capitana and Higuerón. A response action, not an event of either quebrada.
ANA 2016 map 3743 prints the centro poblado label 'LA CAPITANA'.
Road name 'Casa Blanqueada - Higuerón - Rica Playa' (INGEMMET A6764).
ANA 2016 map 3743 centro poblado labels 'HIGUERON' and 'HIGUERON SECO'. Whether these are one or two settlements is not read.
COEN RC 3755: road works in the caseríos Capitana and Higuerón on 17/3/2025.
ANA, Anexo II of DU 015-2023, row 17: SECTOR 'Higueron' for the critical point 'Qda. Hualaca' in San Jacinto.

settlement_context.relation_to_quebrada_hualaca: UNRESOLVED (Anexo II gives Higueron as the sector where the Hualaca critical point lies; nothing more)

statements.statement: Ley 32573 lists 'quebrada Hualtacal' next to 'quebrada Higuerón' on the Contralmirante Villar–Tumbes divide.

Ley 32573 also states that the quebrada Seca 'aguas arriba cambia de nombre a quebrada Hualtacal' on the Canoas de Punta Sal / Casitas / Zorritos boundary. A reach-name change stated by the law for that quebrada Seca; whether it is the same Hualtacal as in §1.2 is not stated.
ANA 2016 maps 3743, 3755, 3761 (Cancas) and 3762 (Canoas de Punta Sal) print 'Hualtacal' labels.
ANA, Anexo II of DU 015-2023, row 18: 'Qda. Hualtacal', distrito San Jacinto, sector Rica Playa (critical point for limpieza y descolmatación).

name_lead_history.r1_result: NOT_ATTESTED in the first bounded capture of 2026-10-08 (SIGRID library search, INDECI media search, full text of every captured document).
name_lead_history.r2_result: ATTESTED by ANA, Anexo II of DU 015-2023, row 17, after the independent review pointed to that annex; archived from the MEF publication on gob.pe.
name_lead_history.lesson: The first capture's searches did not reach decree annexes; absence from a bounded search was correctly not treated as non-existence.

national_inventory_crosswalk.integration: DEFERRED_UNTIL_INDEPENDENT_QA. The audit JSON and its generated Markdown are not edited in this PR. After review, the three unit records can become audit rows with state IDENTITY_ONLY (La Capitana and Higuerón: 2017 rows carry no event date; Hualaca: CRITICAL_POINT evidence only), with every relation left unresolved.

blockers_requiring_external_action: ANA-hosted copy of Anexo II (www.ana.gob.pe/sites/default/files/file_content/Anexo_II_DU015_2023.pdf) timed out from the GitHub runners and has no Wayback snapshot; the archived bytes come from the MEF publication. Someone with access from Peru can fetch the ANA copy so its SHA-256 can be compared.

Relations among Hualaca, Higuerón, Hualtacal and La Capitana (same channel, reach names, tributaries or separate channels) need georeferenced data: ANA hydrography or the faja/intervention files of ALA Tumbes for the DU 015-2023 points, the Ley 32573 cartography (IGN 0863/0864), or a field check.
Geometry and outlet for the three quebradas: no archived source carries a channel line, catchment or outlet; ANA geoservers and repositorio.ana.gob.pe were unreachable from the runners.
Dated events: the only per-unit damage evidence (INGEMMET A6764, 2017) is period-level; Hualaca has only a 2023 critical-point listing.
forbidden_uses: No alias, merge or 'same channel' decision may be taken from this record beyond the identity_decisions listed.
No geometry, outlet, receiver, parent basin or footprint may be derived from map label order or from district names.
The 2017 road-damage rows are not dated events, not footprints and not discharge or capacity evidence.
Settlement exposure statements (INDECI 2024) are not quebrada events.
Missing names in COEN reports are not evidence of inactivity (UNKNOWN_NOT_LOW_RISK).
Different names, separate table rows or separate map labels are not evidence of hydraulically independent channels.
The DU 015-2023 critical-point listing is a planned intervention list: not an event, footprint, capacity or priority score.
